page.overview:
Who is Python Demon?

The was a weak demon that menaced Tuoluo Village.

The Python Demon was a colossal red-scaled python with flashing eyes, sword-like teeth, golden claws, and a horn of flesh made from carnelian. Morning fog belched from his nose, scarlet clouds covered his body, and putrid fumes wafted off him.

The Python Demon began menacing Tuoluo Village on Seven Extremes Mountain and successfully killed two exorcists they hired to deal with it.

When Sun Wukong and Zhu Bajie came into town, they easily fought the Python Demon back to its hole. Sun Wukong tricked the demon into swallowing him and beat it up on the inside, keeping it out in the day until it died.
